ops.oldText: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
ops.newText: 2.2 Vendor will be a provider of hosted analytics services to Customer. Customer is under no obligation to purchase any minimum volume of services from Vendor and remains free to obtain analytics or other services from any third party at any time.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have removed the sole-and-exclusive supplier commitment in Section 2.2: our playbook does not permit exclusivity obligations on the customer, and this one would run for the full term with no performance-based exit. It also directly contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges that we have made no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment.
input.summary: Remove Customer exclusivity in § 2.2 and confirm freedom to use other suppliers.
